You know I was theorizing who team JNPR would pick for the doubles round assuming they win. Phyrra is an obvious choice, she is the single best fighter on their team and even if not necessarily as powerful as Nora or as agile as Ren, she's far more agile than Nora and more powerful than Ren, so Phyrra would definitely make it to the doubles and would probably be first pick for the singles round (barring plot twists). The question then is who else would be sent to the second round, it's very hard to tell because like with team RWBY we've gotten to see them fight a LOT and see the general 'chemistry' between all of them on the battlefield which means that you can just look at them as individuals and try to fit them together to compliment each other for their strengths/weaknesses which is why I think that the two they chose were probably the perfect choice (was bit surprised because I thought that we were going to get a slightly different pair due to story stuff), but JNPR we haven't seen fight as much, it's mostly been seeing them fight their own opponents independent of one another, the only time we really saw them working together (beyond simply tagging out in volume 2 episode 1) was back in volume 1 episode 8 before they were officially a team, as a result it's very difficult to know if they've managed to work together to improve how they work together similar to how RWBY has or not.

If they have and as a result we can look at them as individuals, I think Phyrra and Nora would probably be the best, might just be how the series has generally made the male students feel weaker than the female students in general (like Ren getting knocked out pretty easily both in volume 1 episode 8 and volume 2 episode 1, and in the latter he was against powerhouse Yang! That really hurts his cred as a 'ninja' if Yang is able to be as good of a 'ninja' while still being about as strong as Nora!). If however they haven't worked on their in-battle chemistry like RWBY has, then I think that Jaune is actually a contender because him and Phyrra know each other a lot better, not just personally but also battle wise as she helped train him and he sparred against her, add in that time that she used her polarity on his shield (plus that little scene from the trailer where Phyrra jumped off of Jaune's shield) and they've got decent chemistry on the battlefield, the biggest issue then is Jaune isn't as good of a fighter but if he managed to suddenly figure out his semblance either in this round or the next (with story having to make Nora/Ren unable to partake in the doubles match) he POTENTIALLY might be able to hold his own depending on what it is. But then again if Jaune doesn't manage to get his shiz together in time and there is a 'combat chemistry' issue in JNPR then Nora and Ren would probably be chosen for the double round as those two are both competent fighters and they are able to play off of each other well. Really hard to say before we see how they do in the 4v4 round to be able to understand what sort of 'chemistry' they have as a team as well as see if Jaune gets any plot driven powerups (probably won't).

Though I will say, while I think it was probably the best choice, I do find it funny the two that were picked for the double round from team RWBY given how the fights on the train went down...
